name: cutpro
description: Turn long videos and live streams into short clips with AI, then render them and post to TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. Also transcribes audio and video.

interface.longDescription:
CutPro finds the best moments of a long video and turns them into short, captioned vertical clips ready for TikTok, Reels and Shorts.

Paste a YouTube, Twitch, Kick or TikTok link and CutPro clips the video, ranks the clips by how engaging they are, applies your saved templates, renders the final MP4s and posts them to the accounts you connected on cut.pro, now or on a schedule. ChatGPT always asks before starting a job or publishing anything.

It also follows your favorite channels: CutPro clips a live stream while it airs, every 10 minutes, so the best moments are ready before the broadcast ends. And it transcribes audio and video into timed captions in SRT, VTT or plain text.

Everything happens in your own CutPro workspace, the same one you use on cut.pro.
capabilities: Clip long videos into short vertical clips
Clip live streams while they air
Render clips to MP4 and share download links
Post clips to TikTok, Instagram and YouTube
Transcribe audio and video into captions
defaultPrompt: Turn this YouTube video into short clips
Show me the best clips from my last video
Follow this Twitch channel and clip its lives

positive.description: Preview a public video before clipping it
positive.prompt: What is this video about and how long is it? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iG9CE55wbtY
positive.expected_behavior: Calls analyze_video once and answers with the video's title and duration. No clipping job starts.

positive.description: Clip a video after the user confirms
positive.prompt: Clip https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iG9CE55wbtY into shorts. Yes, go ahead.
positive.expected_behavior: Previews the video with analyze_video, starts the job with create_submission once the user agrees, then reports the submission status from get_submission.

positive.description: List the best clips of a finished clipping job
positive.prompt: Show me the five best clips from my most recent video.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the latest video with list_videos, its completed submission with list_submissions, and lists the top five clips from list_clips with title, rating and time range.

positive.description: Render a clip and hand back a download link
positive.prompt: Render the best clip of my most recent video and give me the link to download it.
positive.tools_triggered: list_videos, list_submissions, list_clips, render_clip, get_render, download_render
positive.expected_behavior: Renders the top-rated clip with render_clip, checks get_render until it is completed, and returns the signed download URL from download_render.

positive.description: Read the clips of a monitored live stream
positive.prompt: Which channels am I monitoring for lives, and what were the best clips of the last broadcast?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the live monitors with list_monitors, the latest broadcast of the first one with list_broadcasts, and its best clips with list_broadcast_clips.

negative.description: Image editing is not something CutPro does
negative.prompt: Remove the background from this photo of my dog.

negative.description: Writing a script needs no CutPro tool
negative.prompt: Write a script for a two-minute YouTube video about making pizza at home.
What will the weather be like in São Paulo tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It runs jobs in the user's existing CutPro workspace; nothing is bought or sold inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release. Clip long videos and live streams into short vertical clips, apply saved templates, render MP4s, post to TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, follow channels' live broadcasts, and transcribe audio and video. Users connect by signing in on cut.pro and choosing a workspace.

pt-BR.subtitle: Cortes com IA de vídeos longos
pt-BR.description:
O CutPro encontra os melhores momentos de um vídeo longo e transforma em cortes verticais curtos, com legenda, prontos para TikTok, Reels e Shorts.

Cole um link do YouTube, Twitch, Kick ou TikTok e o CutPro clipa o vídeo, ordena os cortes pelo potencial de engajamento, aplica seus templates salvos, renderiza os MP4 finais e publica nas contas que você conectou no cut.pro, na hora ou agendado. O ChatGPT sempre pergunta antes de iniciar um trabalho ou publicar qualquer coisa.

Ele também acompanha seus canais favoritos: o CutPro clipa uma live enquanto ela está no ar, a cada 10 minutos, e os melhores momentos ficam prontos antes de a transmissão acabar. E transcreve áudio e vídeo em legendas com tempo, em SRT, VTT ou texto.

Tudo acontece no seu próprio workspace do CutPro, o mesmo que você usa no cut.pro.

es-ES.subtitle: Clips con IA de videos largos
es-ES.description:
CutPro encuentra los mejores momentos de un video largo y los convierte en clips verticales cortos, con subtítulos, listos para TikTok, Reels y Shorts.

Pega un enlace de YouTube, Twitch, Kick o TikTok y CutPro recorta el video, ordena los clips por su potencial de interacción, aplica tus plantillas guardadas, renderiza los MP4 finales y los publica en las cuentas que conectaste en cut.pro, al momento o programados. ChatGPT siempre pregunta antes de iniciar un trabajo o publicar algo.

También sigue tus canales favoritos: CutPro recorta un directo mientras está al aire, cada 10 minutos, y los mejores momentos están listos antes de que termine la transmisión. Y transcribe audio y video en subtítulos con tiempos, en SRT, VTT o texto.

Todo sucede en tu propio workspace de CutPro, el mismo que usas en cut.pro.
